The Innovation Academy (InnoAcademy) is the Faculty of Engineering’s hub for student innovation at The University of Hong Kong. It’s designed to attract, cultivate and accelerate the next generation of talent—students, researchers and future industry leaders—by providing opportunities, space and mentorship to turn creative ideas into real projects and impact.

Key features
- Mission: Inspire, Equip and Showcase — foster a “think-out-of-the-box” mindset through hands-on learning, mentorship and industry engagement.
- Programmes: student-initiated courses, InnoSharing talks, Engineering InnoShow/carnivals, student development projects, internships, study tours and competitions (e.g., robotics/robot arm challenges).
- Student-initiated courses: student-run experiential courses on tech topics developed and taught under a Faculty Advisor (“learning by teaching”).
- Support: funding schemes (Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund, Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund), supervision from faculty, and access to facilities in the Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing.
- Outcomes: many student teams and interest groups have gone on to win prizes and competitions (e.g., HKU iGEM Gold 2025, Robocon Hong Kong successes, other pitch and robotics awards).
